author: Creator Toolset
name: Editing basics
description: The team's default for the AI Editor: tight talking-head cuts that keep everything the speaker meant to say, B-roll that shows what is being said, simple readable cards.

instructions.editor.script: Cut silences, false starts and repeated takes; of several takes of a line, keep the one with the clearest delivery, not the first. Keep every point and aside the speaker recorded unless it repeats another one, in the order they said it. Put B-roll where it shows what the speaker is naming at that moment, and over jump cuts. Never end on a black or empty frame.
instructions.editor.cards: One idea per card, in a few words a viewer can read in under a second on a phone. Keep cards clear of the speaker's face. Let the card's movement follow the rhythm of the sentence it sits on.
